Property Summary

This superb detached dormer bungalow is beautifully presented throughout and offers spacious, stylish accommodation in a peaceful countryside setting at Ballymacane, Tacumshane. Lovingly decorated and finished to a high standard, this attractive home combines the tranquillity of rural living with excellent access to the south Wexford coastline, Wexford Town and Rosslare Europort. A welcoming entrance porch leads into an impressive entrance hallway, featuring semi-solid oak flooring and a striking solid oak staircase. The ground floor offers a comfortable living room, together with a versatile bedroom, home office or gym, providing excellent flexibility for modern family life. The superb ash kitchen is a particular feature of the home, with granite worktops and matching splashback. It opens naturally into a generous dining area and bright sunroom, creating a wonderful open and sociable space for everyday living and entertaining. French doors from the sunroom lead directly to the rear garden. A back hall, shower room and large utility room with excellent storage complete the ground floor. Upstairs, there are three generous bedrooms, two with built-in wardrobes. The spacious master bedroom benefits from its own ensuite, while a beautifully finished family bathroom completes the accommodation. Outside, the property sits on well-maintained grounds enjoying the peace and privacy of the surrounding countryside. A detached garage provides excellent additional space and would be ideal for storage, hobbies, a workshop or home projects. The location is a major attraction. Ballymacane is ideally positioned for enjoying some of County Wexford’s finest beaches, including Rosslare Strand, Carne, Curracloe, and Rostoonstown, while nearby Our Lady’s Island and Tacumshane offer beautiful countryside, scenic walks and a wealth of local history. Tacumshane Windmill and Sigginstown Castle two of the area's distinctive historic landmarks, are also close by. The wider area offers excellent opportunities for walking, cycling, golf, water sports and coastal activities, with attractions including the Raven Nature Reserve, Wexford Wildfowl Reserve and the Hook Peninsula within easy reach. Wexford Town provides an excellent choice of shopping, restaurants, schools, services and cultural amenities. Rosslare Europort is conveniently accessible for ferry connections to the UK and continental Europe, while Rosslare Strand railway station and local bus services provide further transport options. The regional road network also offers convenient connections towards the N25 and M11/N11, making the property an attractive choice for commuters and those travelling throughout the southeast. This is a beautifully finished and exceptionally well-presented home offering generous accommodation, excellent storage, attractive outdoor space and a superb combination of countryside tranquillity and coastal convenience. An excellent opportunity to acquire a quality detached family home in a highly desirable part of south County Wexford.

Viewing is highly recommended!
